reached_sql:
SELECT
    customer.c_last_name,
    customer.c_first_name,
    customer.c_salutation,
    customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    dj.ss_ticket_number,
    dj.cnt
FROM customer
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        store_sales.ss_ticket_number,
        store_sales.ss_customer_sk,
        count(*) AS cnt
    FROM date_dim
    JOIN store_sales
        ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
       AND store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
       AND date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
       AND date_dim.d_year IN (2000, 2000+1, 2000+2)
    JOIN household_demographics
        ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
       AND (
            household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
            OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
       )
       AND household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0
       AND CASE
               WHEN household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0
               THEN household_demographics.hd_dep_count / household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count
               ELSE NULL
           END > 1
    JOIN store
        ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
       AND store.s_county IN (
           'Williamson County',
           'Williamson County',
           'Williamson County',
           'Williamson County'
       )
    GROUP BY
        store_sales.ss_ticket_number,
        store_sales.ss_customer_sk
) AS dj
    ON dj.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, customer.c_last_name ASC
